limitations: One training seed and 256 selected held-out rows; three-seed full held-out and baseline-capability release gates remain pending.
Teacher-forced next-token diagnostic, not free-generation accuracy.
NVML and RSS sample peaks are lower bounds. Missing phase samples remain null; maximum gaps and sample counts are retained.
Host RSS sum can double-count shared pages; GNU time and VmHWM are process-lifetime high-water marks, not phase-local peaks.
Host RSS/PSS/HWM measure process memory; unmapped filesystem page-cache memory was not measured. Media hashing and decoding can populate material page-cache memory outside these measurements.
CUDA counters and external sampled peaks occur at different times; do not subtract their maxima to infer untracked allocations.

The two training jobs overlap on different A100 nodes; frozen/trained evaluation arms run sequentially within each precision. Filesystem/cache state is uncontrolled; native update throughput excludes loading, validation and checkpoint writes.
Training input-length/frame distributions were not recorded; evaluation shapes are not evidence of those training distributions.
